description: Read an app's user reviews, newest first, up to 100 per page: rating, title, text, version, date, developer reply and AI tags (sentiment, intent, severity, topic) where tagged. Filter by stars (rating='1-2' for complaints), version, date range, text (q) or AI tags (intent='bug,crash'; tag filters skip untagged reviews). Page with cursor. Cost: 1 per page + 1 if the US reviews are refreshed credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

country.description: ISO country code(s): `us` (default), a comma list (paid plans), or `all` (Studio). Example: us,de

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

intent.description: AI intent filter (comma list): bug, crash, feature_request, pricing, ux, praise, spam, other. Example: bug,crash

max_age.description: Refresh the latest US reviews when older than this many seconds. Default 86400 (1 day).

q.description: Case-insensitive text search in the title and body. Example: crash

rating.description: Star rating filter, `1`, `1,2` or a range `1-3`. Example: 1-2

sentiment.description: AI sentiment filter (comma list): positive, neutral, negative. Example: negative

since.description: Only items at or after this ISO date / datetime. Example: 2026-10-01

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

topic.description: AI topic filter (comma list of topic labels, case-insensitive, or topic ids).

until.description: Only reviews created before this ISO date / datetime.

version.description: Only reviews written for this app version.

name: get_reviews
title: Get Reviews
